notes: Wide white AX scan head with black inset front/side faces is attached to the left imaging port, unlike the much thinner C2 scanner.
Facility #51 stock image includes an additional NSPARC detector, while other facility photos show core AX; optional NSPARC hardware is excluded from this shared core asset.
Every model has documented physical scale anchors; total installed envelope is inferred for the photographed configuration, not an official dimensional specification.
No exact, openly licensed complete mesh found in recorded searches; original procedural meshes, no manufacturer image textures.
Digital stage/focus motion only; no optical performance, hardware control or protocol adapter is validated.

Four 11mm-long narrow leveling-foot necks bridge the former 7mm scanner support gap, overlapping existing feet and scan-head shell by 2mm each. Original object transforms, joints and closed envelope are preserved; support detail is an authored mechanical visualization.
